Second slug (supersonic-distribution-services-pvt-ltd, address 722 Marker Chamber V, Nariman Point, Mumbai-400021) shows a separate export lane: "2022-12-09 | SUPERSONIC DISTRIBUTION & SERVICES PVT.LTD. | TO ORDER | RICE BRAN | Calcutta, India | Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam | 100601 | BOL CCU200CB7H00" plus 4 more rice-bran rows to Vietnam (BOL CCU2001CB200, CCU2009BB200, CCU20C870700, CCU200CB7H00). Source counter vs rows seen: header claims 173 shipments / 3 trading partners / 5 ports; only 5 India export rows were visible on the free page (plus 5 Vietnam rice-bran rows on the second slug) — the remaining ~163 records are paywalled and unverified.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report domestic split could be retrieved: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and volza.com / eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403. The only India-side trace is indirect — an export invoice referencing a third-party GSTIN "GST NO.27AAFCA4659K1ZB-TAX INV.NO.SH/0158/25-2" (that GSTIN belongs to the battery supplier named in the goods description, not necessarily to the subject company). No domestic supply record found; not asserted either way.
note: Actual export shipments are confirmed by dated customs/B-L records: Sep 2025 lanes Nhava Sheva/Mundra/Bombay Air Cargo -> Lagos (Nigeria) and Cotonou (Benin) with BOL numbers 9703575, 5491568, 7134561, 7379555, 1764554, and a 2022 rice-bran lane Calcutta -> Ho Chi Minh City (BOL CCU200CB7H00 etc.). Declared HS 850490 (parts of transformers/static converters) does NOT match the observed cargo: actual HS codes seen are 85389000, 39095000, 85072000, 85446090, 85044010 and 100601 — the company is a multi-commodity trader, not a 850490 manufacturer. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground: record actual HS as observed and treat the company as a trader (role: trader). Two different registered addresses appear under near-identical names (One BKC, Bandra-Kurla Complex vs 722 Marker Chamber V, Nariman Point) — possible duplicate/renamed entity or two distinct legal persons; CIN/PAN not public in retrieved sources, so identity linkage is unconfirmed. Domestic (India) supply evidence: none found — no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP award or contract located; search tooling was down and paid sources blocked, so this is 'unknown', not 'none'. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public in free sources; the 173-shipment counter is a record count, not a value).
